items.name: Change Target FOV
items.description: Changes the target field of view for the "Camera FOV" mod.

items.name: Change Tinnitus Hertz
items.description: Changes the target hertz for the tinnitus mods.

items.name: Knockback Multiplication Amount
items.description: Adjusts how much your knockback is multiplied.

items.name: Exit Fun Settings
items.description: Returns you back to the settings menu.

items.name: Anti Mute
items.description: Includes the mute button with the anti report mods.

items.name: Hide Anti Cheat Report Reasons
items.description: Hides the reason for Show Anti Cheat Reports.

items.name: Smart Anti Report
items.description: Makes the anti report mods only activate in non-modded public lobbies.

items.name: Visualize Anti Report
items.description: Visualizes the distance threshold for the anti report mods.

items.name: Change Anti Report Distance
items.description: Changes the distance threshold for the anti report mods.

items.name: Change FPS Spoof Value
items.description: Changes the target FPS for the FPS Spoof mod.

items.name: Change Ping Spoof Value
items.description: Changes the target ping for the Ping Spoof mod.

items.name: Exit Safety Settings
items.description: Returns you back to the settings menu.

items.name: Fast Kick
items.description: Instantly creates a room instead of checking if one already exists.

items.name: Graphic Punch Mod
items.description: Spawns blood projectiles when hitting other players with the allowed punch mods.

items.name: Kick Fix
items.description: Stops the super infection, virtual stump, and other kick mods from breaking.

items.name: Kick to Public
items.description: Makes the kick mods send the user to a public lobby. This allows for chaining of commands.

items.name: Kick to Specific Room
items.description: Makes the kick mods send the user to the specific room of your choice.

items.name: Legacy Kick Freeze
items.description: Makes call overflow related kick methods freeze the rig instead of putting it in the low event state.

items.name: Mute All on Freeze
items.description: Whenever you freeze the server, everyone will be muted along with it.

items.name: No Freeze Za Warudo
items.description: Disables the freezing on the "Za Warudo" mod, turning it into a fun mod.

items.name: Rejoin on Kick
items.description: Makes room based kick mods join the room you kicked the target in once they have been kicked.

items.name: Unlock on Crash
items.description: Unlocks the room when crashing someone. This makes the mod more powerful.

items.name: Change Lag Power
items.description: Changes the power of the lag mods.

items.name: Change Lag Type
items.description: Changes the method used to lag players.

items.name: Master Visualization Type
items.description: Changes the indicator placed on the master client for mods that show one.

items.name: Exit Overpowered Settings
items.description: Returns you back to the settings menu.

items.name: Isolate Others
items.description: Allows you to still be seen when isolating players.

items.name: Public Room Guard
items.description: Automatically disables all enabled detected mods when you join a public room.

items.name: Switch to Modded Gamemode
items.description: Automatically sets the gamemode as modded when changed.

items.name: Exit Detected Settings
items.description: Returns you back to the main page.

items.name: High Quality Soundboard
items.description: High-quality: 48kHz mixing, peak normalization, soft limiting — best quality to you and lobby.

items.name: Loop Sounds
items.description: Makes sounds loop forever until stopped.

items.name: Overlap Sounds
items.description: Makes it so you can play sounds over and over again, making them overlap eachother.

items.name: Sound Bindings
items.description: Changes the button used to play sounds on the soundboard.

items.name: Soundboard Local Volume
items.description: How loud the soundboard is to your ears (local preview). 0-200%.

items.name: Soundboard Mic Volume
items.description: How loud the soundboard is through your microphone to others. 0-200%.

items.name: Exit Soundboard Settings
items.description: Returns you back to the settings menu.
